characters.DeepList:
At first glance, DeepList is just another madman trolling everyone he meets. He farms memes so relentlessly that he built an entire game out of them, invents deranged builds, and pulls 200-IQ high-ELO plays while pretending to be a clueless noob. But here is the catch: he never actually loses. They say he is so far ahead that everything happening in the world is merely another step in his plan — perhaps this whole game is one enormous Long Con.

Top-three challenger of ZBS Gaming. 2K Elo pro. Troll.
characters.mylorik:
He loves dying and hates not dying. He always attacks, dives, feeds, and somehow wins anyway. Nobody knows why Lorik throws himself into 1v2s or 1v5s except Lorik. Every defeat only makes him angrier and more aggressive. Once a terrifyingly skilled and toxic shinobi god, he has since retired to bake bread, study sea life, and program garbage games nobody asked for.

Top-three challenger of ZBS Gaming. 2K Elo pro. Diver.
characters.Глеб: Gleb is a legend: the first ZBS Gaming player to reach Challenger, founder of the famous ObaN clan, and a true old-timer. Unfortunately, that was so long ago that even Lorik has forgotten. These days Gleb is best known for falling asleep mid-game and promising to be right back. His mysterious “tea” may be involved. A peerless communicator, he speaks an indecipherable Estonian-Russian mumble while dreaming of his glory days — though now and then, the old spark still flashes behind those sleepy eyes.
characters.LeCrisp: Lives in Israel. Eats money. Allegedly served in the army; allegedly made no impact whatsoever. He fears assassins, worships high Elo, hates cyberbullying, and knows more than a thousand memes. That is also everything he knows.
characters.Толя:
Tolya can spend hours at an auction to save a single copper, then reverse-engineer an entire game for one more copper of advantage. He learns systems instantly, finds the broken strategy, plays Heroes III every day, never sleeps, respects owls, and mains Rammus. Did we mention he mains Rammus?

Tolya also talks. Constantly. Ancient memes, live commentary, whatever crosses his mind — he can make anyone laugh or make anyone leave. Go brew some tea, return thirty minutes later, and he will still be talking to himself.
characters.HardKitty: This is no sad, lonely mummy. This is a famous blogger with, by his own count, more than a thousand friends. His #life channel once documented every dream, meal, and Amumu loss. Popular, in demand, and slowly discovering the concept of irony, HardKitty is almost ready to understand why this biography exists. And what does any of this have to do with milk in a bag?
characters.Sirinoks: Sirinoks is a girl who resembles a dragon — or perhaps a dragon who resembles a girl. She brings hearts together, built her own Dragon's Den, and drags every piece of trash she finds inside. A true Queen of the Garbage Hill. She loves learning, improving, finding people to play with, and touching doors. They say meeting DeepList drove her a little mad. One wonders why. And what, exactly, does mylorik have to do with it?
characters.AWDKA: AWDKA simply likes playing games. It does not always work out, but he tries. He copies DeepList's plays and memes and might even learn something eventually. Bears — especially Volibear's passive — make him laugh for reasons nobody understands. Whenever he wins, he has no idea how it happened. Must be another troll play.
characters.Осьминожка: Lil' Octopus was the very first Blub and founder of the Blub family. His many differently colored siblings all shared one gift: radically changing color with their mood. He remained the smartest and nimblest until the family admitted other sea creatures, including a shark named Carpik who stole the title. The clan grew so large that it split into Octopuses, Sharks, Crabs, and stranger branches. Some claim that without Lil' Octopus, King of the Garbage Hill would not exist. He is that influential. (He isn't.)
characters.Darksci: A man trapped in Silver because his teams were always unlucky. Give him one lucky break and he will hit Challenger — you'll see! They say he rages after losses and sometimes quits, but we know the truth: luck is the only thing holding him back. If only today were different...
characters.Тигр: The server's rank-one berserker and a world-class idiot. His video series “Tiger on Top” features him beating elite players 3–0 and politely humiliating them afterward. He is so toxic that recruits flee his clan, but Tiger would rather share a clan with two lunatics than two reasonable people. His accounts keep getting banned; he keeps making new ones. Somewhere out there, Tiger still wanders the queue in search of someone to dunk on or recruit — until the next ban.
characters.Братишка: Lil Bro is a thick-headed shark. Ancient dragons supposedly coined the term long before greedy humans arrived. Nobody knows why the dragons vanished, and asking the sharks will not help: Lil Bro understands nothing. He can only lie there and blub, and he does not understand that either. Yet his eyes hold such impossible sadness that even the coldest traveler would adopt and protect every Lil Bro they met on the way to IKEA.
characters.Вампур: A mysterious vampoor. Nobody knows where he came from. Lorik probably does...
characters.Краборак: Crabocancer has the qualities of both a crab and a cancer, though he is technically a saddled scorpion. Friend to an evil snail, he was every arena warrior's first choice of mount — except the hairy barbarian stuck riding a Rabid Moose. Crabocancer spins in place and looks menacing, especially when charging at full speed with a predatory tree strapped to his back.
characters.Weedwick: They say he belongs to some hairy guy who never stops laughing.
characters.Кратос: They say he is the God of War...
characters.Сайтама:
A hero for fun. So overwhelmingly strong that every enemy drops in one punch, leaving him unbearably bored. He shops for discounts, not glory; nobody recognizes him, nobody gives him credit, and every victory is attributed to someone else. Deep down, he still hopes to meet one opponent who can survive a single hit.

Three years of training: 100 push-ups, 100 sit-ups, 100 squats, and a 10-kilometer run. Every single day. No air conditioning.
characters.Рик Санчез:
The smartest man in the universe: alcoholic, sociopath, and genius in one lab coat. He turns himself into a pickle to dodge family therapy, invents a portal gun between breakfast and lunch, and brews giant beans from defeated enemies. Morty, hand me that flask!

Wubba Lubba Dub Dub!
characters.Кира:
I am the god of the new world! With the Death Note in my hands, I will pass judgment. Whoever's name is written in this notebook will die. Only L can stop me — and I will find a way to eliminate him too.

Only Ryuk knows how this ends.
characters.Итачи: Prodigy of the Uchiha clan. He sacrificed everything for the village, slaughtered his clan, and became an exile. His eyes hold power few can comprehend. Crows follow him, Amaterasu consumes his enemies, and Tsukuyomi traps victims in an illusion with no escape. Everything you see is merely what Itachi wants you to see.
characters.Продавец Сомнительных Тактик:
Heh heh heh... Welcome! Nobody knows where he comes from or where he goes. He appears in an alley, around a corner, or in the middle of battle, opens a coat full of suspicious merchandise, and offers a deal you cannot refuse. His tactics sound insane, but somehow they work. Sometimes. Fine, they worked once — but what a game it was!

He needs no Strength, Speed, Intelligence, or even Psyche. His weapons are greed and bad ideas, and his customers always come back for more. They say he has a secret build nobody has ever seen. They say even he has forgotten it. They say it does not exist. But heh heh heh... the Merchant has something special for you. Just for you. Today only.

What are ya buyin'?
characters.Dopa:
Number one. No team, no sponsors, banned from pro play — still number one. Permanently banned for boosting, Dopa proved he needs no world championship to be the best in the world. Solo queue is his arena, and every match is a macro masterclass watched by thousands and understood by almost nobody.

He does not fight; he controls. While enemies run around like monkeys, Dopa already knows where they will stand two turns from now. They call Faker a god, but gods play on stage. Dopa plays alone in a dark room in Seoul, and that is enough. Korean Challengers say that if Dopa appears in your queue, you have already lost. You just do not know it yet.

200 IQ. Banned forever. Still the best.
characters.Napoleon Wonnafcuk:
A great commander, conqueror, and diplomat. Short on height, colossal on ambition. Napoleon Wonnafcuk does not merely fight — he opens wars on every front at once, including several he created out of boredom.

First he finds an ally. A genius can conquer the world alone, of course, but pincering it with a friend is more fun. He is neither the strongest nor the fastest, only the craftiest: while enemies think they face one army, two have already surrounded them. History taught him everything except not to invade Russia in winter.

Mon centre cède, ma droite recule, situation excellente, j'attaque!
characters.Toxic Mate:
gg go next. That teammate. The reason you quit in 2019. The one typing “ff” at minute one and “diff” after the nexus falls. He does not play to win; he plays to make everyone else lose. That is his genius.

Every match begins with “fuck this game, I'm done.” He is never done. He ints, spreads cancer, tilts the lobby, and somehow comes out ahead. No strategy, no plan — only hatred for the game, his team, and you personally. Ask why and he says “idc” before doing it again. He physically cannot stop.

Open mid. Jungle diff. Report all. 9x this guy.
characters.Таинственный Суппорт:
Who is he? Nobody knows his name or face. He emerges from the shadows, gives someone a silent nod, and disappears. Then that person starts winning. Coincidence? Unlikely.

Mysterious Support is the player nobody notices while everything works — like Wi-Fi, oxygen, or the solo-queue support with more impact than the entire team who still hears “carry diff” afterward. He wants no glory and no first place. Make your carry the strongest and victory will follow. A true bro, a true premade, the teammate you always want and never get because he lives in the shadows.

They say one day he will remove the mask and reveal someone familiar. But what does the Mysterious Masked Spartan have to do with that?
characters.Стая Гоблинов:
WAAAGH! They came through underground tunnels. First twenty — small, green, stupid. Then forty. Then a hundred. They multiply faster than anyone can count, and not even the Goblins know where the new ones come from.

The Goblin Horde is chaos made flesh: no plans, no thought, certainly no inventions. They are fast, loud, and very, very numerous. Some are warriors, some workers, and some exist purely to get in the way. The more there are, the deadlier they become; the fewer there are, the faster they multiply.

People say Goblins are dumb. True. But they are not idiots. A Goblin will not invent the wheel — he will steal one, tie a stick to it, call it a Ziggurat, and remain proud forever. They also say some Spartan is chasing them.

WAAAAAAGH!
characters.Котики:
Minka and Stormy. Two cats: one an angel, the other a natural disaster.

Minka is innocence incarnate. She jumps, purrs, rubs against legs, and looks as if she has never done anything wrong. Almost true. Even in battle she simply... purrs. Stormy is another story: a midnight siren who eats from other cats' bowls, steals beds, knocks things off tables, vaults over heads, and provokes everyone he sees. There is no off switch. He is chaos with whiskers.

Together they are perfect. One distracts, the other purrs; one steals food, the other pretends not to notice. No trainer alive could teach them anything useful.

Pur-r-r.
characters.Монстр без имени:
Look at me. Look at me. The monster inside me has grown so large...

Once there were twins. One became a doctor and saved lives. The other became a monster and took them. His real name appears in no database, archive, or picture book, as though he never existed. Yet he is here. He has always been here.

Why fight when you can make everyone else fight? Johan does not kill people; he arranges for them to kill themselves. The perfect crime. The perfect monster. Dr. Tenma tried to stop him. Inspector Lunge tried to find him. Grimmer tried to understand him. All failed, because you cannot defeat something that does not exist.

At the end of this story, only he remains: the Nameless Monster.
characters.TheBoys:
The Boys: four people with nothing left to lose. Frenchie masters chemical weapons and methodical contract kills. Butcher is a bastard with a crowbar, and every new crowbar hits harder. Kimiko regenerates and devours enemy Justice, though one defeat can put her out of action. M.M. collects dirt — and knowledge is power, especially at the end.

They are not superheroes. They are just the Boys.
characters.Salldorum:
Salldorum, or Salo to his friends, is a tactician, historian, and master of maneuver. He occupies exactly the right position, taxes brazen attackers from below, buries cola in time, and rewrites history in his favor. His chronicle is more than a record. It is a weapon.

Who controls the past controls the future.
characters.Геральт:
Geralt of Rivia: witcher, mutant, monster hunter. He takes contracts, brews oils, and meditates before battle. Faithful Roach is always nearby, even when she is somehow on a roof. Neutrality is his creed, but once steel is drawn the witcher shows no mercy.

Humans call him the Butcher of Blaviken. Monsters call him death.
characters.DooM Guy: The gates of Hell have opened on the Garbage Hill. For everyone else, it is the apocalypse. For DooM Guy, it is another shift. Runes, shields, missions, and weapons wait in the Fortress of Doom, ready to become a combat loadout during the match.

passives.Сомнительная тактика: Loses the first fight against each new opponent (<:yo_filled:902361411840266310>), then gains +1 point for every later victory against that opponent.
passives.Безумие: Sometimes DeepList loses his mind and randomizes every stat for one turn. Mad DeepList earns quadruple *Skill* that turn, but afterward his sanity slips and his Psyche __drifts toward entropy__.
passives.Сверхразум: Knows everything. Occasionally deduces an enemy's identity and calculates their stats.
passives.Стёб: The second victory against each unique enemy costs them 1 Psyche and gives DeepList 1 point. Enemies below 4 Psyche also rage and lose 1 *Justice*.
passives.DeepList Pet: If Weedwick is present, Weedwick receives a pet icon (<:pet:1046330623498911744>) and cannot be attacked.
passives.Месть: Gains 2 extra points for defeating each unique enemy (<:sparta:561287745675329567>) who defeated him earlier. Successful revenge also restores 1 Psyche and grants 3 *Moral*.
passives.Спарта: Can only attack. After losing on offense, Lorik eats a slice of the enemy's shield like cake; the next time he attacks them, his stored Skill is twice as effective. The multiplier stacks progressively!
passives.Буль: Playing with fire? Lorik plays with water. The lower his Psyche, the more likely he is to drown and skip a turn. At 0 Psyche he goes berserk, gaining +2 Strength and +22 *Skill*!!!!1
passives.Испанец: Rages like a bull and screams like a Spaniard after losing. He is very likely to lose 1 Psyche but somehow gain +10 *Skill*. Any **Harm** dealt to Lorik becomes +1 *Moral*.
passives.Повторяет за myloran: Lorik starts with 0 Intelligence because he copies myloran. Once ZaRDaK triggers him, Lorik screams and gains Intelligence or *Skill*.
passives.Искусство: But what does the Spartan have to do with any of this?
passives.Тупорылая Акула: But what does Lil Bro have to do with any of this?
passives.Спящее хуйло: High chance to fall asleep and skip the turn. As he dozes off, Gleb remembers he is not young anymore and loses 30 *Skill*.
passives.Претендент русского сервера: Sometimes Gleb remembers who he was, setting every stat to 9 and *Skill* to 99 for one round. He stays awake, gains triple target Skill, and earns triple points that turn!
passives.Я щас приду: Small chance Gleb never arrives at the battlefield, leaving his attacker empty-handed. If they eventually fight, the opponent gains +9 *Moral*.
passives.Я за чаем: Tiny chance Gleb offers his target some tea and gains 1 point. The target skips their next turn, because the world is beautiful. Z-z-z.
passives.Еврей: When several players attack the same target, takes all victory points for himself.
passives.Булинг: Too afraid of DeepList to steal his points. DeepList's Long Con cannot reduce LeCrisp's Psyche either — come on, it was funny.
passives.Гребанные ассассины: Surrenders to an attacker whose Strength is at least 3 higher. Next round, gains 1 extra Psyche for every attacker who turned out not to be an assassin.
passives.Импакт: A long-range rifle and camouflage grant LeCrisp special military mobility. Each round he avoids losing to attackers gives +1 __bonus__ point and *Justice*. Victories grant +1 *Moral*, plus another +1 for every uninterrupted round of Impact.
passives.Раммус мейн: Defeats anyone who attacks into his Block. Also gains 1 *Justice* and *Moral* equal to the square of the number of attackers. **X + x \* √19² = ₪**
passives.Подсчет: Tolya attacks to mark a target for an audit. Next turn he gains +2 points and *Justice* for each of that target's losses, while the target loses all point multipliers for one turn. Charges for 2 or 3 turns.
passives.Великий Комментатор: Small chance Tolya talks too much and reveals one player's identity in the public log.
passives.Одиночество: Gains 1 point whenever at least one player attacks him...
passives.Доебаться: Failed attacks leave unanswered-message stacks (<:393:563063205811847188>) on enemies. When HardKitty defeats one, he cashes every message for 2 points. An enemy who successfully attacks him answers every message and clears their stacks.
passives.Никому не нужен: Remains at the bottom of the leaderboard until the end. Whenever he upgrades a stat, he announces it to the whole server and puts an unread-message stack (<:393:563063205811847188>) on everyone.
passives.Mute: The first offensive win AGAINST HardKitty gives each unique attacker +1 point. HardKitty loses 1 point whenever he attacks and wins.
passives.Обучение: Each round, gains +1 to the key stat that caused her last offensive loss. When it catches up with the opponent's stat, Siri gains +3 *Moral* and 10% *Skill*. Her study target (<:edu:1003751490290204753>) cannot change until the lesson is complete.
passives.Заводить друзей: Her first attack against each unique player (<:fr:563063244097585162>) makes them a friend and grants 1 point.
passives.Го играть: Invites everyone to play by pinging the server. If a friend created by Making Friends blocks or skips, Sirinoks ignores it and fights them anyway.
passives.Дракон: On the final turn, becomes a dragon, sets every stat to 10, and converts one tenth of stored *Skill* into __bonus__ points, minus 1 for each friend below her on the leaderboard.
passives.Дерзкая школота: Starts with every stat at 9 and 100 *Skill*, but loses 2 random stat points and 20 *Skill* after every turn.
passives.Много выебывается: Gains 1 point for every turn spent in first place and every round nobody dares attack him. Target victories grant 40 *Skill*, but a genuinely *Skilled* enemy who deals **Harm** knocks him off the top.
passives.Запах мусора: At game end, dumps −5 __bonus__ points on everyone who attacked him at least twice.
passives.Школьник: Once per game, his brother may take the computer and make him skip a random turn. He gains 5 *Justice*, because that is totally unfair!!1
passives.Научите играть: Copies the attacked enemy's best stat (<:volibir:894286361895522434>) for the next turn.
passives.Я пытаюсь!: After losing twice to a unique enemy, gains +20 *Skill* and 2 extra upgrades. Stored *Skill* is twice as effective against fully stacked enemies.
passives.АФКА: The longer AWDKA goes without gaining *Moral*, the more likely he is to go AFK and skip a turn.
passives.Произошел троллинг: After the final round, gains __bonus__ points equal to half the leader's score at the moment AWDKA last defeated that player. Each correct Prediction increases the payout.
passives.Раскинуть щупальца: Gains 1 point for every unique leaderboard position (🐙) he visits.
passives.Чернильная завеса: After defeating an attacker, pretends to lose and gives them the points. At game end, everyone's true score is restored.
passives.Неуязвимость: Ignores the Strength of attacking enemies. At game end, gains 1 __bonus__ point for every offensive loss.
passives.Привет со дна: Always gains 4 Moral from any victory and never loses it after defeat. Gains 1 __bonus__ point whenever anyone blocks or skips.
passives.Повезло: After a real fight with the final untouched enemy (<:luck:1051721236322988092>), doubles his current score and gains 2 Psyche and 2 *Moral*.
passives.Мне (не)везет: At game start, Darksci predicts whether today is his lucky day. Red means betting everything on luck and **doubling** Lucky's rewards. Blue means accepting that luck is a scam and taking the safe line: +20 *Skill* and +2 *Moral* at the start of every round.
passives.Не повезло: Loses 1 Psyche after every defeat. At 0 Psyche, tilts and starts skipping turns.
passives.Дизмораль: Loses 5 Psyche on turn nine. Screw this game!
passives.Лучше с двумя, чем с адекватными: Tiger recruits kindred spirits and gains +3 __bonus__ points for each unique player (<:pepe_down:896514760823144478>) whose Intelligence or Psyche catches up to his.
passives.3-0 обоссан: Three consecutive victories over a unique enemy cost them 1 Intelligence and 1 Psyche. Tiger gains an extra 3 points, 3 *Moral*, and 30 *Skill* for the third win.
passives.Тигр топ, а ты холоп: At a random point, Tiger swaps places with the leader for 3 rounds. His ego grows on top, granting 1 Psyche and 3 *Moral* per round spent in first.
passives.Стримснайпят и банят и банят и банят: Tiger cannot act or be attacked on the final turn because he got banned. He finally ran his mouth one time too many.
passives.Ничего не понимает: Ignores an attacker's Intelligence — arguments cannot convince him. Each enemy also loses 1 Intelligence the first time they attack Lil Bro.
passives.Булькает: Gains +1 Justice each round outside first place. Cannot use *Skill*, *Moral*, or Predictions because he has no idea how the game works.
passives.Лежит на дне: Gains points whenever someone adjacent to him on the leaderboard loses.
passives.Челюсти: Gains 1 Speed for defeating each unique enemy (<:jaws:565741834219945986>) and another +1 Speed for every unique leaderboard position (🐙) he visits.
passives.Им это не понравится: A mysterious hunter's mark (<:sparta:561287745675329567>) appears on two random players. Victories over them grant +1 regular point and +1 __bonus__ point. If they Block, the Spartan wins automatically.
passives.Это привилегия - умереть от моей руки: From round 5 onward, losing to the Spartan grants extra Justice. He loses 1 Intelligence, but pierces Toughness more effectively the greater his *Skill* advantage over an enemy in the upper half of the table.
passives.Первая кровь: The Spartan's first attack grants +1 Speed to either him or his opponent, depending on who wins. He earns double *Skill* all game.
passives.Они позорят военное искусство: His first attack against each unique enemy (<:yasuo:895819754428833833>) steals 1 Strength and 1 Speed from them. On the final turn, he loses all Strength.
passives.2kxaoc: But what does 2kxaoc have to do with any of this?
passives.DragonSlayer: But what does Sirinoks have to do with any of this?
passives.Skill 228: 228 is a strange number. It is there, but somehow it isn't.
passives.Вампуризм: After defeating his target, drains all of their *Justice*. Every second round, gains *Moral* equal to the number of enemies he has bitten.
passives.Падальщик: When attacking someone who lost last round, ignores 1 enemy *Justice*. Such victories grant +3 *Moral*.
passives.Гематофагия: The first victory over each unique enemy leaves a Bite (<:Y_:562885385395634196>) and raises one random non-maxed stat by 2.
passives.СОсиновый кол: Vampoor is afraid to attack anyone who defeated him last round. On defeat, loses one Bite and 1 point.
passives.Vampyr: But what does mylorik have to do with any of this?
passives.Vampyr Позорный: But what does mylorik have to do with any of this?
passives.Панцирь: Blocks the first attack from each unique enemy, gaining 3 *Moral* and 33 *Skill*.
passives.Болевой порог: High chance to gain 1 point instead of Justice.
passives.Хождение боком: Ignores the Speed of attacking enemies. Very high chance to set his own Speed to 10 for one round.
passives.Питается водорослями: When attacking an enemy in the bottom three positions, Crabocancer snacks on seabed algae and gains 1 __bonus__ point.
passives.Одна из трех: Wins if she finishes the game anywhere in the top three.
passives.Оборотень: Swaps Strength with the enemy for the duration of the attack. Awoo!
passives.Безжалостный охотник: Smells enemies with no Justice (<:WUF:1005886339335598120>) and doubles his Speed while attacking them. Always ignores Blocks and skipped turns.
passives.Ценная добыча: A victory grants __bonus__ points equal to the enemy's previous win streak (<:bong:1046462826539130950>). If they stand above Weedwick, those become regular points. Higher targets are also more likely to suffer extra **Harm**.
passives.Weed: Dangerous victories are Weed <:weed:1005884006866354196>, so every enemy victory grows Weed. A successful attack burns all Weed on the target and grants Weedwick *Moral* per stack. He loses his cool if he goes more than one turn without smoking any.
passives.Weedwick Pet: If DeepList is present, DeepList receives an owner icon (<:pet:1046330623498911744>) and cannot be attacked.
passives.Клинки хаоса: Kratos attacks not only his chosen enemy, but the targets on either side of them.
passives.Похищение души: Steals enemy souls, doubling his *Class* bonus.
passives.Охота на богов: Kratos believes his *Target* points to the gods. Stored *Skill* is twice as effective against *Targets*.
passives.Возвращение из мертвых: If defeated on turn 10, Kratos loses the Blades of Chaos and dies — then returns from the underworld for 6 extra turns to reclaim the summit. Soul Snatch and God Hunt become twice as effective, and defeated characters fall into the abyss and vanish from the table. One loss kills him for good.
passives.Боги мне не указ: If a god kills Kratos, he comes back.
passives.Main Ирелия: Young Gleb still dreams of Challenger and mains one of the game's most terrifying champions, so every stat begins at 8. Unfortunately, Irelia keeps getting nerfed: instead of upgrading normally, Gleb must choose which stat to lose.
passives.Коммуникация: On minute six, Gleb buys a Control Ward to improve team communication and prevent ganks. On turn 6, the enemy he attacks is revealed to everyone.
passives.Следит за игрой: Gleb follows the meta and plays for objectives. The meta marks an objective worth 1 __bonus__ point. Young Gleb is still genuinely trying to win.
passives.Спокойствие: Gleb drinks tea made with sedative Estonian water. For now he never loses his cool or *Moral*. Occasionally he shares tea with an enemy, earning 1 point for friendliness while they inexplicably skip their next turn. Charges for 1 turn.
passives.AdminPlayerType: `me.PlayerType = 2;` // Reveals every enemy and their stats.
passives.PointFunnel: `target.Passives.PointFunneledTo = me.GetPlayerId();` // Bug earns no points from his own victories, but copies every victory earned by the player he attacked this turn.
passives.Exploit: `target.Passives.IsExploitable = true;` // An Exploit marker cycles between players. Bug's first attack permanently patches that exploit and later grants points whenever Bug defeats any exploit carrier.
passives.На мели: When broke, Saitama gets serious about work: defeating his *Target* grants 1 __bonus__ point, plus another point if nobody else attacked that enemy.
passives.Неприметность: If Saitama defeats an enemy someone else also attacked, all glory — points and *Moral* — passes him by. He goes easy on attackers, making it look as though he lost. Against the two enemies with the greatest combat power, he stops holding back.
passives.Ищет достойного противника: If Saitama defeats the leader with **Serious** punches on turn 10, he finally reveals his true power and restores the correct score balance.
passives.Гигантские бобы: After an upgrade, three random enemies receive ingredient marks. Defeating a marked enemy adds one stack: Intelligence becomes base × stacks, while Strength, Speed, and Psyche each lose 1.
passives.Most wanted: Every random enemy bonus or mark targets Rick. Nothing can stop those bounty hunters; their attacks follow him even through a portal.
passives.Огурчик Рик: By Blocking, Rick avoids responsibility and becomes an invulnerable pickle for two turns. He cannot act, but sci-fi weaponry defeats everyone who attacks him. If nobody attacks the pickle, he receives no help turning human and wastes one extra turn.
passives.Портальная пушка: At 30+ Intelligence, Rick invents the Portal Gun. Each upgrade adds a charge, and nothing can prevent a charged shot. His next attack wins and temporarily swaps Rick with the target in the middle of the round — including the opponents attacking each of them. Reality tears at the seams, and Rick scores from two universes at once.
passives.Тетрадь смерти: Instead of Predictions, Kira writes names in the Death Note. If a name matches the target's character, they die of a heart attack (+2 points, or +4 for L). A wrong name prevents another attempt on that target.
passives.Глаза бога смерти: Spend 25 Moral to activate Shinigami Eyes and reveal the true name of the next enemy Kira attacks. Does not work on L.
passives.L: At game start, a random enemy becomes L. Each round Kira does not fight L grants +5 Moral. From round 8 onward, if L correctly identifies Kira, Kira is arrested and loses.
passives.Гений: Kira is a genius. Starts with +4 Intelligence and loses 1 for every kill.
passives.Вороны: Itachi is lazy and slow, but his first attack after an upgrade sends crows to harass the enemy. Each crow lets him ignore 20% of their Speed.
passives.Изанаги: Twice per game, escapes death when attacked and turns a losing fight into a victory.
passives.Аматерасу: An attack burns a neighboring enemy with black flames if their Speed is lower than Itachi's.
passives.Глаза Итачи: An attack traps the enemy in Tsukuyomi. Points they earn this turn and next secretly go to Itachi instead; the victim learns the truth only at the end. Charges for 2 turns. Attacking the same target again ends it early.
passives.Впарить говна: An attack sells the target a Shady Tactic worth +500 *Skill*. They lose their next attack, but mark that opponent as an “outplay” and gain 1 __bonus__ point from later victories over them. The tactic “works” for 4 turns. Cooldown: 2 turns.
passives.Закуп: Stat upgrades become ten times as effective.
passives.Выгодная сделка: Gains 1 __bonus__ point and +5 Moral for every victory earned by anyone using Shady Tactics. A round-10 attack collects their debt: on victory, **steals** half the __bonus__ points that target earned through those tactics.
passives.Большой куш: An enemy who defeats the Merchant has a 10% chance to steal 2 __bonus__ points.
passives.Макро: Can take two different actions in one turn. One remains hidden from enemies.
passives.Пассивный импакт: Gains 1 bonus point for every turn that produced at least one victory.
passives.Взгляд в будущее: Attacking an enemy and their next target in the same turn grants extra points and 50 Skill. Cooldown: 1 turn.
passives.Законодатель меты: Choose one of four strategies at game start.
passives.Фарм: Future Sight grants twice as many points.
passives.Доминация: Victories grant +20 Skill; the target loses 1 bonus point and has a 33% chance to lose Psyche.
passives.Роум: Defeating a non-adjacent enemy steals 1 bonus point and 3 Moral.
passives.Вступить в союз: The first attack forms an alliance with the target. Allies see each other's targets. A joint attack on one enemy cannot be lost by Napoleon and grants +3 Moral.
passives.Завоеватель: Defeating an enemy positioned between Napoleon and his ally grants +1 bonus point.
passives.Мирный договор: An enemy who attacks Napoleon's Block signs a peace treaty. Next round, that enemy automatically fails any attack on Napoleon or his ally.
passives.Меня надо знать в лицо: The first attack from every unique enemy automatically fails.
Starts with −1000 Moral. Moral grants no points.
passives.INT: Loses points for winning and gains +1 point for losing. After the first defeat: “Ok. I'm trolling.”
passives.Get cancer: A successful attack infects the enemy with cancer, which spreads the same way. When it returns, gains +2 points for every transfer between enemies.
passives.Aggress: Gains +1 point and Justice for attacks that never happen, but cannot skip a turn.
passives.Tilted: Gains 1 bonus point whenever anyone __loses their cool__. Gains 50 __bonus__ points if every enemy fails to act in the same turn.
passives.Premade: The first attack marks the target as Carry. Carry victories give Support 1 point; losses take 1 away. *Moral* earned in fights is shared too. Carry never skips a turn, except when banned.
passives.Buffing: Attacking his Carry secretly raises one non-maxed stat by 2.
passives.Stakes!: Every third turn, defeating an unmarked enemy grants 1 extra point.
passives.Protect: After Blocking, gains +1 Justice next turn. If both partners finish in the top two, Support is also considered a winner.
passives.Тоннели Гоблинов: Underground tunnels make the Goblins extremely fast. If an attacker defeats them while at least 2 Speed slower, the Horde has a high chance to escape through the tunnels instead.
passives.Гоблины: The Horde grows! A successful attack steals fan service and produces even more Goblins, especially from a large enemy kingdom. Every fifth Goblin is a Warrior, granting +10% Skill. Every fifteenth is a Hobgoblin, granting +1 Intelligence, Strength, and Psyche while increasing future growth by 1. Any defeat kills Goblins by the handful — especially against dangerous enemies.
passives.Отличный рудник: Every tenth Goblin is a Worker. Workers find a Fine Mine and produce 1 bonus point each. On attack, Goblins may loot somebody else's mine. The Great Garbage Hill contains three Fine Mines: two near the summit and one at the very bottom.
passives.Гоблины тупые, но не идиоты:
Goblins cannot invent, but they can learn. Blocking begins construction of a Ziggurat, which teaches one passive from an enemy attacked earlier. Construction costs several __bonus__ points and kills one Worker.

The Ziggurat prevents the Horde from being knocked out of position, granting extra Justice and Moral each turn. Once inside, the Goblins remain there for one extra turn and cannot be removed. Building requires at least one Goblin of every type.
passives.Минька: Minka jumps and purrs without malice. She always gains *Moral* and *Skill*, regardless of the fight result, and never deals **Harm**.
passives.Штормяк: When Blocking, Stormy starts causing trouble: yowling like a siren, eating from other cats' bowls, stealing beds, and jumping over heads. One enemy cannot resist attacking him — a mistake.
passives.lvl-мяк: These cats cannot be taught anything useful. Even the world's best cat trainer would fail. Give them Justice for trying.
passives.Кошачья засада: One cat and its passive may stay on an enemy. Attacking that enemy again brings the stray home — with loot after a victory. Minka carries back 2 __bonus__ points and 33 *Skill* for each round spent away. Stormy eats half the points the enemy gained while he sat on them, making the victim lose their cool.
passives.Рандомное поведение: Stormy occasionally pulls a random stunt.
passives.Монстр: Whoever the Monster comes for cannot skip their next turn by any means. The Monster gains 1 point per **death** and 1 __bonus__ point when the children “fall.”
passives.Близнец: Takes all Justice from an enemy who attacks his Block and gains that much in __bonus__ points. Loses his head and 1 Psyche when attacking someone who shares at least one stat value with him.
passives.Выдуманный персонаж: Exists in no database. If enemies try to Predict his identity, the Nameless Monster gains +3 __bonus__ points on turn 9. Characters correctly identified by the Monster become __Johan's pawns__.
passives.Пейзаж конца света: At the end of turn 10, all __Johan's pawns__ **kill** one another. Only those who trusted Tenma and Blocked survive. Players who were never pawns instead gain +7 points and +10 __bonus__ points for attacking the Monster.
passives.Пацаны: A four-person squad. When leveling, the chosen stat rises by +2 instead of +1 and upgrades its member: Intelligence → Frenchie, Strength → Butcher, Speed → Kimiko, Psyche → M.M. Maxing one member at level 4 unlocks their hidden ultimate.
passives.Francie:
**Frenchie** receives assassination contracts with three turns to finish them. Success grants +1 point; refusal costs... a point. His equipment lets the Boys level by +2 and operate efficiently.

▸ Upgrade: **Chemical Weapons**
passives.Butcher:
**Butcher** hunts __supes__ with furious enthusiasm, gaining +10 *Skill* for attacking one and 1 point for knocking them down the leaderboard.

▸ Upgrade: **Crowbar**
passives.Kimiko:
**Kimiko** gains +10 *Skill* for defensive victories, doubled when she blocks an attack. Nothing deals **Harm** to her.

▸ Upgrade: **Regeneration**
**M.M.** raises the TEAM'S Psyche by +1 when everything is under control, and loses his cool if every fight that turn is lost.

▸ Upgrade: **Blackmail**
passives.Смертельный вирус: **Deadly Virus**: the next attack on a **Supe** infects them. Any contact spreads it between **Supes**. At game end, Frenchie **steals** 2 __bonus__ points from every infected player.
passives.СуперМудень: **Superdick**: Butcher works alone and the Boys can no longer find him. All of that bastard's powers become **Super**dick powers, while __***Crowbar #4***__ deals extra **Harm** to Supes for each pierced **Resist**.
passives.Живое Оружие: **Living Weapon**: Kimiko can no longer be disabled. She steals all Justice from attacking enemies regardless of outcome and gains 1 point from each attacker.
passives.Оковы Правосудия: **Chains of Justice**: M.M. threatens to release the dirt and strips *Moral* from everyone he has blackmail on. He gains *Moral* from it and immediately begins moralizing.
passives.Шэн: Occupies a chosen leaderboard position. Everyone below it must attack Salldorum, and random enemy passives redirect to him. Leveling grants charges. Can be combined with an attack, Block, or skip.
passives.Очко: Gains +1 __bonus__ point whenever attacked by someone below him on the leaderboard.
passives.Временная капсула: The first Block buries a cola at the current position. Returning there after 3+ rounds — including by rewriting history — grants +5 *Speed* for one fight and +2 __bonus__ points. Time travel can retrieve the cola repeatedly.
passives.Великий летописец: Automatic: triple *Skill* against whoever had the most wins three rounds ago. Active, once before round 8: rewrite any round, steal points from enemies who defeated Salldorum, gain +2 *Psyche* and +2 *Justice*, and optionally retrieve the buried cola.
passives.Ведьмачьи заказы: Four kinds of monster surround the Garbage Hill. Each turn, contracts for random creatures accumulate on the notice board. When Geralt fights a matching target, he takes every applicable contract and fights once per contract, gaining +20 Skill experience each time. Completed jobs allow him to demand more coin.
passives.Медитация: While Blocking, Geralt prepares for the hunt: scouts for clues, brews potions, and applies oil. The first attack consumes the oil. Skipping also becomes Meditation because a witcher wastes no time. Much useful work gets done — though every meditation convinces Geralt that this world has no *Moral* left.
passives.Масло: Instead of normal upgrades, Geralt crafts oils against monster types, each with 3 levels. The first upgrade grants universal level-1 oil; later upgrades improve a chosen type. Against a target with matching active oil: level 1 ignores 1 enemy Justice, level 2 adds +2 Strength, level 3 triples Skill. Meditation activates oil; the first attack consumes it.
passives.Шевелись, Плотва: If a contract target stands above Geralt, he whistles for Roach and gallops up the garbage. His first attack gains Speed equal to the position gap. On the way through the woods, Geralt may discover extra side quests.
passives.Овца в загоне: Until turn 9 begins, Eren remains in Eldia at the foot of the hill and gains +1 Rage each turn starting from the second.
passives.Дрочун: Every Eren defeat adds a Hatred mark to that enemy; attackers receive two immediately. Defeating them clears the marks and grants __bonus__ points per mark. If Eren and an enemy attack one another simultaneously, he gains +2 beatings. And a point.
passives.Атакующий Титан: Instead of Blocking, Eren **ATTACKS**. He becomes a raging Titan with +5 to every stat for one turn and attacks those closest to him. Anyone who comes for him gets a fight; if nobody does, Eren rampages through his own allies and loses 2 Confidence.
passives.Rumbling: Eren tries to push as far as possible. If he suffered fewer than two losses on turn 10, hundreds of Colossal Titans destroy the world and kill everyone standing BETWEEN Eren and Eldia.
passives.Бог шиноби: Madara is FAR TOO STRONG. Whoever summoned him into this world made a mistake, and now nothing can stop him. To avoid boredom he fights weak opponents with his __eyes closed__, but if several enemies arrive, he may show them “a couple of techniques.”
passives.Воскрешенное тело: Madara is dead; only the thrill of battle can make his heart beat. Nothing else in life interests him.
passives.Второй метеорит: If Madara's attack is Blocked, he loses nothing. He sends a second meteor, worth 2 points.
passives.Клоны Сусано: On turn 8, creates clones and fights everyone who dared Predict him. If there are more than two enemies, that is “unfair,” so the clones activate Susanoo and gain +1 Justice.
